package example.bankwealth.v2.application.aggregates.behaviors

import akka.persistence.typed.scaladsl.Effect
import example.bankwealth.v2.application.aggregates.FundQuotaProtocol._
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities.FundQuotaEntity.{Event, State}
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.invariants.FundQuotaRules
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.services.FundQuotaComputations
import net.imadz.common.application.CommandHandlerReplyingBehavior.runReplyingPolicy

object FundQuotaBehaviors extends FundQuotaCommandHelpers {

  def apply(hosts: FundQuotaComputations): CommandHandler = (state, command) =>
    queryBehavior(state)
      .orElse(executionBehavior(state, hosts))
      .apply(command)

  private def queryBehavior(state: State): PartialFunction[Command, Effect[Event, State]] = {
    case GetState(replyTo) =>
      Effect.reply(replyTo)(state)
  }

  private def executionBehavior(state: State, hosts: FundQuotaComputations): PartialFunction[Command, Effect[Event, State]] = {
    case cmd: ReserveSubscriptionQuota =>
      runReplyingPolicy(new FundQuotaRules.ReserveSubscriptionQuotaRule(hosts), ReserveSubscriptionQuotaHelper)(state, cmd)
        .withPost(FundQuotaRules.checkEventPostconditions)
        .replyWith(cmd.replyTo)
  }
}
